name: morphing-discovery-bar

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the full pill bar at rest with the search circle and active Explore tab.

tagline: Category pills blur away as the search circle grows into a field.
summary: A rounded row of category pills with a search button at one end. Clicking search widens it into a typing field while the category pills blur and slide off, and a close button brings them back.
appearance: A dark rounded capsule bar holding a small circular search button and four icon-and-label pills; the active pill gets a pale tinted background and a coloured label, while the others stay neutral grey.
behaviour: Tapping the search circle springs it open into a wide input while the category pills blur, shrink and slide away, and a round X appears beside it. Pressing X clears the text and morphs the pills back into place.
demo_content: Explore, Trending, Music and Food with compass, flame, note and fork icons; a jazz brunch search query.
search_phrases: category pills that turn into search
search icon expands into a field
tab bar that collapses for search
pill tabs with a search button
search takeover animation in a toolbar
segmented bar that becomes an input
use_when: A filter row should stay compact but still offer search without opening a separate overlay.
avoid_when: The search field is visual only: typing filters nothing and no search callback fires.
customise: Pass a categories array of id, label, icon and the two active colours; the spring timing and the morph sizes are constants inside the source.
weight_why: A handful of pills and one input running layout and blur springs.

a11y.note: The search and close buttons are icon-only with no label or clear focus style, so their purpose is unclear to keyboard and screen-reader users.

issues: The search field is decorative: typing filters nothing and no search callback fires.
Frames 3 and 5 catch the morph with the whole bar smeared into an unreadable blur.
polish_why: Confident spring morph with tidy colour coding; the non-functional search lets it down.
title: Morphing Discovery Bar
